productions_published_needs_slug.name: productions_published_needs_slug

production_props_item_xor_video.name: production_props_item_xor_video
production_props_item_xor_video.value: (item_id IS NOT NULL AND video_id IS NULL) OR (item_id IS NULL AND video_id IS NOT NULL)

generated.as:
(case status
            when 'pending' then 0.80
            when 'accepted' then 0.70
            when 'delivered' then 0.60
            when 'finished' then 0.50
            else 0.40
          end) + (case when quote_id is not null then 0.05 else 0 end)

(case status
            when 'pre_quote' then 0.90
            when 'pending' then 0.80
            when 'in_progress' then 0.70
            when 'in_rent' then 0.60
            when 'completed' then 0.50
            when 'sold' then 0.40
            else 0.30
          end) + (case when order_id is not null then 0.05 else 0 end)

warehouse_stock_reservations_expiry_idx.name: warehouse_stock_reservations_expiry_idx
warehouse_stock_reservations_expiry_idx.where: released_at IS NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

warehouse_products_root_idx.name: warehouse_products_root_idx
warehouse_products_root_idx.where: parent_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

website_customizations_primary_unique.name: website_customizations_primary_unique
website_customizations_primary_unique.where: is_primary = true AND deleted_at IS NULL
